name: Production dual-hash runtime integration and safe opening-book migration

antecedentDirectPlay.meaning: The isolated research candidate did not show a material regression in this preregistered screen.

wasm.change: Production search now maintains and checks an independent secondary position identity.

openingBookMigration.meaning: No ambiguous legacy move payload is copied onto multiple independent identities, and no recovered entry with an illegal stored move is emitted.
openingBookMigration.notClaimed: Disconnected entries are not proven unreachable after arbitrary off-book play.

runtimeCoverage: JavaScript V20 transposition and evaluation caches
JavaScript repetition and mate-solver identity paths
WASM private and shared transposition tables
localValidation.correctnessGain: Cache and book reuse require both independent position identities instead of accepting a primary-hash match alone.

finalBinarySpeedDiagnostic.comparison: Integrated 36,545-byte production WASM versus the decoded immutable 35,597-byte pre-integration production snapshot
finalBinarySpeedDiagnostic.aggregateBoundary: The all-block aggregate is disclosed but optimistic because one baseline block had an isolated system-load delay.

live.reason: The production-integration branch had not yet completed its pull-request, merge, deployment, and post-deployment verification sequence.

supported: The production-source candidate closes the reproduced primary-hash-only identity hole across the listed runtime paths.
The production WASM and SBK2 asset have the recorded byte counts and SHA-256 identities.
The NNUE weights are byte-for-byte unchanged.
The earlier isolated research candidate passed only a bounded non-regression floor.
The final exact production WASM showed no gross direct-WASM speed regression in the bounded local diagnostic.
notSupported: The engine gained Elo or is stronger because of the dual-hash change.
The engine has reached stable high-dan strength.
The integrated 36,545-byte production WASM itself completed the earlier 96-game match.
The live site already serves these assets.
The 0.251% opening-book coverage loss is guaranteed never to affect a game.
The short direct-WASM diagnostic proves browser-host or shared-TT performance.

nextGate: Merge only after the current integration validation is complete, then verify the deployed asset identities and browser engine path before marking the change live.
